title: Tiling
description: Replicate a live source across an N×M grid where each tile drifts from its neighbours: a per-tile hue rotation walks across the grid and a per-tile time offset pulls each cell from a different moment of a rolling frame history, so the same gesture ripples across the wall a beat apart. Optional kaleidoscopic mirror weave flips alternate tiles, and hue/time can radiate from the centre. Columns, rows, hue-per-tile and time-per-tile are live. Tiles the camera, a dropped photo or clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
